name: Harvest
description: A warm, organic grocery theme with a farmers-market soul. Olive and harvest-orange tones, an elegant serif display over Inter, and layouts built for seasonal produce, local sourcing and whole-food storytelling.

blocks.heading: Fresh from the fields
blocks.subheading: Seasonal produce, local growers and whole foods — delivered to your door at their peak.

blocks.heading: Locally grown
blocks.text: Sourced from farms and makers near you.

blocks.heading: Picked at peak
blocks.text: Harvested for flavour, not shelf life.

blocks.heading: Next-day delivery
blocks.text: Order today, unpack it fresh tomorrow.

settings.heading: Straight from grower to doorstep
settings.body: We skip the middlemen and buy direct from local farms and small producers. Shorter journeys mean fresher food, fairer prices for growers, and a lot less waste along the way.

settings.heading: Weekly boxes, zero fuss
settings.body: Let us do the planning. Pick a fruit-and-veg box, set your frequency, and we'll fill it with the best of the season — flexible, pausable, and always good value.

blocks.quote: The veg actually tastes of something again. We've cancelled the supermarket shop.
blocks.author: Weekly-box member

blocks.quote: Knowing which farm my food came from makes all the difference. Lovely service.
blocks.author: Verified buyer

blocks.quote: Fresher, less waste, and my kids finally eat their fruit. Worth every penny.
blocks.author: Loyal customer

settings.heading: What's good this week
settings.subtext: Seasonal recipes, grower stories and members-only offers — a fresh note every week.

blocks.heading: Next-day delivery
blocks.text: Chilled and carefully packed to your door.

settings.text: Free next-day delivery on your first box

settings.heading: Real farms, real people
settings.body: Every grower we work with is chosen for how they farm — with care for the soil, the seasons and the flavour. We visit, we taste, and we pay fairly so good food keeps being grown.

settings.heading: In tune with the seasons
settings.body: We stock what's actually in season, so it's fresher, cheaper and better for the planet. Our weekly boxes change as the harvest does — a little surprise every week.

settings.heading: Chilled, careful, on time
settings.body: Fresh and chilled items travel in insulated, recyclable packaging and arrive next day. Choose your delivery slot at checkout, and reschedule any box in a tap.

blocks.question: How fresh is the produce?
blocks.answer: Most fruit and veg is picked or delivered to us within 24 hours of dispatch, so it reaches you days fresher than a typical supermarket shop.

blocks.question: How do the weekly boxes work?
blocks.answer: Choose a box and a frequency, and we'll fill it with the best of the season and deliver on schedule. Pause, skip, swap items or cancel any time before your cut-off.

blocks.question: Is your packaging really plastic-free?
blocks.answer: Our aim is zero single-use plastic. We use paper, compostable film and returnable insulation, and we're transparent about the few items still in transition.

blocks.question: What if something arrives not up to scratch?
blocks.answer: Fresh food should be perfect. If anything isn't, tell us within 48 hours with a photo and we'll refund or replace it, no fuss.

blocks.question: Do you deliver to my area?
blocks.answer: Enter your postcode at checkout to see available delivery days. We're adding new areas all the time as we sign up more local growers.
